commentary.text: 90+11' John Brooks shows a yellow card to Richarlison (Tottenham) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.

90+3' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) now unnecessarily receives yet another yellow card, which means only one thing for him: an early bath.
